meta.matrix_convention: all matrices are row-major nested arrays: M[i][j] = R's M[i,j] (1-based in R, 0-based in JSON)
meta.description: Bootstrap_GoF(mles, Y, X, num_boot) on the regression_d3_n200 dataset (same X, Y and MLE par as regression_d3_n200.json)
meta.seed_note: set.seed(99) immediately before the Bootstrap_GoF call; nothing else consumed the RNG after loading the stored dataset
meta.stochastic_note: Stochastic sanity fixture only. Each bootstrap round draws n ESAG(1, mu_k, gamma_k) deviates (one MASS::mvrnorm(1,.) each, i.e. rnorm(3)) from the fitted Bx rows, refits MLE(c(mles), Y_b, X) with HESS=TRUE (default), recomputes T1 and ks.test(T1_boot, 'pchisq', 2)$p.value. test_statistics is itself the KS p-value of the observed T1 residuals (not the KS D statistic), and p_value = mean(test_statistics >= stats_boot).
